highlights: UGREEN 6-in-1 USB Hub allows you to connect a variety of devices. It can transmit data at speeds of up to 10 Gbps.
HDMI 2.0 port supports a maximum resolution of 4K*2K@60Hz, providing high-quality images and videos.
Compact and lightweight, you can carry it anywhere and use it anytime.

Multiple connections: Supports multiple device connections with a USB-C male port, 2 USB-A 3.2 ports, 1 HDMI port, 2 USB-C 3.2 ports and a PD port, making it compatible with a variety of devices, such as computers, smartphones, tablets and other accessories.
High speed: Supports USB 3.2 standard, providing data transmission at speeds of up to 10 Gbps, and is also backward compatible with USB 3.0/2.0/1.1.
High video quality: HDMI 2.0 port supports a maximum resolution of 4K*2K@60Hz, allowing you to connect to a monitor or projector to display high-quality images and videos.
Support fast charging: The PD (Power Delivery) port supports charging at 20V and 5A, allowing you to charge your devices quickly and efficiently.
Durable design: The body is made of durable aluminum and provides good heat dissipation, making it stable and safe to use.
Portability: With a compact and lightweight design, it is easy to carry and use anywhere, anytime.
Compatibility: Compatible with a wide range of devices, including Windows, macOS, and Android operating systems.
